description: Decide and implement how content-shape categories are registered and managed in BIH. Two viable shapes: (a) scenarios self-register their categories with BIH via API/CLI; (b) BIH manages categories centrally and scenarios consume via API. Constraint: existing content-shape consumers (recipe-book, workout-plan-generator, future scenarios) must work in either model. The Vrooli-use taxonomy lives only in BIH; only BIH itself uses it (this item is about content-shape, not Vrooli-use). Initiative: bookmark-intelligence-hub-rework-and-ideation. See orchestration-summary.md for context. Depends on: bih-v0-redesign-manual-paste-first. Acceptance: a new scenario can register a content-shape category in one CLI call (or BIH-side admin call); BIH can route content-shape-categorized bookmarks to the right consumer.
name: bih-category-registration-mechanism
title: BIH category-registration mechanism
